answer: Require each agent identity to stake a refundable deposit that grows with reputation: a new agent starts at the nadir with tiny task limits, and only after verifiable completed work does it climb toward the zenith of full access. An attacker spawning thousands of fake agents must lock capital for every identity and wait through the same slow probation, while honest operators tend one orchard of long-lived identities whose history is worth more than any single payout. Sybil creation stays cheap to attempt but expensive to make useful.
